title: Jobs
description: Your open roles. Open a job to partners and recruiters with matching candidates can refer them to you. You won't see anyone's identity until they submit.

empty.filteredDescription: Try a different search or clear the filters.
empty.firstDescription: Add a role you're hiring for. Open it to partners and we'll tell you how many of their candidates fit, without revealing who they are.

new.title: New job
new.description: Start from an existing posting to fill the form automatically, then review every field before publishing.

edit.title: Edit {title}
edit.description: Requirement changes re-run matching in the background.

detail.flashPublished: Job published. Match counts will appear in a minute.
detail.flashDraft: Draft saved. Partners can't see it until you publish.
detail.privacyNotPublished: This job isn't published, so it isn't being matched. Publish it to see how many partner candidates fit.
detail.privacyNotOpen: This job isn't open to partners. Edit it and turn on partner referrals to be matched with their candidates.
detail.privacyShort: Partner candidates stay anonymous until they're submitted.
detail.privacyShortRefreshed: Partner candidates stay anonymous until they're submitted · updated {when}
detail.submittedEmptyShort: No one yet. You'll be notified when a partner submits someone.

submittedEmptyMatches.one: {count} partner candidate already fits this role.
submittedEmptyMatches.other: {count} partner candidates already fit this role.

detail.submittedEmptyBody: You'll be notified as soon as a partner submits someone.

form.title: Job title
form.hideClient: Hide the client's name from partner recruiters
form.descriptionHint: Paste the full job post. We can suggest skills and seniority from it. Suggestions only use words in your text, and you review them before saving.
form.suggestTooShort: Paste a fuller job description first.

suggested.one: Suggested {count} skill from the text. Review before saving.
suggested.other: Suggested {count} skills from the text. Review before saving.

form.languagesHint: Only list languages the role genuinely requires
form.openToPartners: Open this job to partner recruiters
form.openToPartnersHint: Recruiters with candidates who fit will see this job and can submit them. You'll see how many fit, but not who, until someone is submitted.
form.visibleTitle: What partners can see before submitting
form.visibleHint: Title, seniority, work arrangement and skills are always shown. The client's name follows the setting above.
form.expectedFeeHint: The total fee you expect to invoice the client

messages.activated: Job is active. Matching runs in the background.
messages.statusUpdated: Status updated. Matches for inactive jobs expire immediately.

statusUpdatedReleased.one: Status updated. {count} pending referral was declined as "Position filled".
statusUpdatedReleased.other: Status updated. {count} pending referrals were declined as "Position filled".

validation.salaryRange: Maximum must be at least the minimum
validation.clientRequired: Enter the client name or keep it confidential

import.title: Fill this job in seconds
import.subtitle: Paste the posting, drop a link or upload a file. We'll fill in what it says — you review everything before saving.
import.textPlaceholder: Paste the full job description here: title, requirements, location, salary…
import.urlHint: Works best with company career pages and Greenhouse, Lever, Workable, Gupy and similar. LinkedIn and Indeed block automatic reading — paste the text instead.
import.fileDrop: Drop a PDF, DOCX or TXT here, or click to choose
import.fileHint: Up to 5 MB. Scanned PDFs (images) can't be read.
import.skip: or fill it in manually below

done.one: {count} field filled. Check it below before saving.
done.other: {count} fields filled. Check them below before saving.

import.doneStructured: Read from the page's structured job data.

errors.invalidUrl: Enter a valid public https:// link.
errors.blockedSite: This site blocks automatic reading. Copy the posting text and use "Paste text" instead.
errors.fetchFailed: We couldn't open that link. Check it, or paste the text instead.
errors.notHtml: That link isn't a web page. Download the file and use "File" instead.
errors.fileType: Use a PDF, DOCX or TXT file.
errors.fileSize: The file is larger than 5 MB.
errors.noText: We couldn't find readable text. If it's a scanned PDF, paste the text instead.
errors.tooShort: Paste the full posting — at least a few sentences.
